run_train_script: run the f5_tts training script with hydra config to train a CFM TTS model
build_cfm_model: build a CFM model with a transformer backbone, mel spec kwargs, and vocab char map
init_trainer: init a Trainer with model, epochs, learning rate, batch size, and checkpoint settings
load_training_dataset: load a training dataset with tokenizer and mel spec kwargs for f5_tts training
get_text_tokenizer: get a text tokenizer and vocab size from a tokenizer path and tokenizer type
